website.note: Site still references NAVIGATE recruitment but ctgov status is TERMINATED; no new active studies disclosed.

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Galectin's lead pivotal Phase 2b/3 NAVIGATE trial of belapectin in MASH/NASH cirrhosis to prevent esophageal varices (NCT04365868) was Terminated (primary completion 2025-03-11) following negative top-line interim results announced December 2024. The 10-K notes R&D activity is winding down post-NAVIGATE and the company is exploring partnerships/strategic options. No new sponsored P1/P2/P3 trials are currently active per ClinicalTrials.gov as of this snapshot.
